entries.4e65e33a2db3eda1: As its management philosophy, the company advocates “Kyōsō” (co-creation), and states that its purpose of existence is to contribute to society by realizing an affluent society through information technology and payments and by fulfilling customers' inspiration and dreams. Toward achieving its new management vision “Challenge1000”, the company says it will work on maximizing group synergies, developing growth markets through capital and business alliances and expanding stock business, strengthening support for DX promotion, and advancing sustainability management and human capital management. Because the target figures for the vision and plan concern future matters, they are not transcribed here.

entries.ef950d839af08b29: The company describes itself as an independent IT vendor that provides one-stop service from SI, software development, system implementation support to operation and maintenance; provides data center environments with advanced seismic isolation, redundant power supply and multilayer entry and exit security measures; and runs an information security business with world-class security products and their technical support. In collection agency services, the company has a record of launching in April 1973 the first collection agency service by a private company in Japan using direct debit in partnership with financial institutions, and it presents itself as a comprehensive payment provider responding to diverse payment needs.
